coverage.r1: Read all 1030 lines in order. Transcript is mostly Latin-letter Arabic from ~05:00 on (causative/get-X verb drill, prepositions, commands); Arabic script only in the warm-up (00:13-04:48) and scattered words. BIG HOLE 20:17-31:41: the engine dropped nearly all of Medi's and Amal's Arabic words (blank gaps like 'So is it ?', 'Either here', 'Or, or') - the made-me-laugh / tiring / meetings / parents / smile sentences are unreadable; only Amal's chat shows the targets (el-musalsal da77akni, el-shu8ul ta3abni/mut3eb, huwwe beyzahhe2 el-kul, el-6ayyara ta33abatni, el-ijtima3aat beyzah2uni, ahli za33aluni, da77akto). 16:34-19:10 and 21:01-25:30 are English meta discussion (verb-adjectives bizahhe2/bi5awwef/mut3eb). 47:06-48:57 English chat about Farsi. Echoes (engine words = Arabic): 00:17 'يمني، يمني' = mnee7 mnee7 (good); 05:38 'زهرت تك' = zahha2tak; 06:49 'Zehe at' = zhe2at; 09:13 'kuffet' = 5ufet; 49:17 'is it attack?' = ed7ak; 53:21 'is hai, ma is hai hala' = ma tezha2i halla; 1:01:06 'The heck, the heck no' = da77akni (chat el-filem mbaare7 da77akni); 59:21 Amal 'Shutul' = shu kaman?/shu tul?; 16:34 'bizaghe' = beyzahhe2. Not written: 03:04 مختلف->مختلفة self-fix (GR-22); 03:41-04:13 clock time 'tlaat'/'tes3a u 3eshreen' -> Amal 'tentain'/'sitte u 3eshreen' = wrong time of day (fact), not language; 09:13 kuffet->5ufet and 46:13 sawa->sawwa, 53:44/58:42 double-T (tedta3eb, matabina) = pronunciation S4; 12:16 'Hasabit or hasabti' and 55:58-56:11 him/her = questions, not slips; 19:55 kunt->kan self-fixed; 31:36 5awwafthom accepted by Amal ('both right'); 39:45 illi - Amal said 'Illi. Good job' as he produced it, treated as help on the way; 4:27 'beige' appears in her own chat so not tier 3. Names: Zara (brand), Diane, Jolene, Renata/Renad, Japan, Farsi - never glossed.
coverage.r2: Large stretches 19:25-31:45 have Medi's and Amal's Arabic words STRIPPED by the engine (lines like 'So is it ?', 'is it or-'), so the work / flight / meetings / parents drills can only be judged from her chat lines; rows 16-19 are low confidence for that reason.
